builds.hypothesis: R3 allybelow40%HP heal is1.5*(350+0.5AP). AP/Staff buff/heal power strengthen it; Revitalize low-health condition measured separately. Deathcap/Zhonya/Banshee increase AP ratio. Staff suppliesAP plus pretriggered40AP Rapids; Redemption/Mikael supply22% combined heal/shield power. Their active heals are excluded. No penetration credit to healing/shielding. 30min Gathering Storm AP is fixed; Revitalize tested on allybelow40%HP; Aery reported separately.

kitEvidence.formula: Soraka calls upon divine powers, restoring [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP] Health to all allied champions, regardless of distance. Healing is increased to [(150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP) × ((1 + 0.5))] on targets below 40% Health.

builds.name: Astral Infusion: one direct ally heal
builds.summary: Investigate high one direct Astral Infusion heal output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one direct Astral Infusion heal output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: W directly restores 90/110/130/150/170 + 0.5 AP health to another allied champion. Rejuvenation can reduce Soraka health cost and transfer a separate regeneration effect, but neither makes the direct W coefficient larger. AP competes with heal-and-shield power and Dawncore conversion.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Recipient ally: 6000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 30%, observation 3s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap observed healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Seraph transformed. Caster at full health with legal health/mana cost available, no Rejuvenation active. One ally at 30% of 6000 maximum HP receives one W. Record caster HP cost and direct recipient recovery; no recipient Visage, ally buffs or item-active heal.

kitEvidence.formula:
Soraka restores [90 / 110 / 130 / 150 / 170 + (0.5) × AP] Health to another allied champion.

If Soraka is affected by Rejuvenation, the Health cost will be reduced by [(0.8 / 0.85 / 0.9 / 0.95 / 1) × 100]%, and the target will gain Rejuvenation for @Spell.SorakaQ:HoTDuration@ seconds.
